name: Gensei Shinki Sacred FD
original_name: 幻聖神姫セイクリッドFD
source:
This Fandisc contains the following scenarios

・「Invisible Attacker」
One day, the boys at school act strangely and sexually assault the girls at school. The boys, who are clearly under some evil influence, even start to attack Tina and Setsu who can't transform! What will Forneus do when the event has come out like this!?

・「Minotaur's Bride」

Sacred Claire has lost and has been captured. Her life as a prisoner and being violated everyday by the sorcery beast, Minotaur, has begun. Rajiel's cold smile appears as she looks down upon Claire's humiliated and disgraceful state. What will be the fate of Sacred Claire who continues to suffer pregnancy, birthing, and being milked!?

・「Starting from today, I am the protagonist! Dream and ambitious of extravagant life」

Gotou, an executive of Foundation, is the embodiment of authority and lust. He takes the advantage when Forneus's absence and succeeds in placing submission seals on Tina and Setsu. With the power of the seal, he takes away Tina's and Setsu's freedom. Without their freedom, the girls are violated At home, at school, and even after transformation. Gotou even goes as far as targeting the girl who noticed Tina's and Setsu's abnormalities. Too bad for the girls, his libido has no limit.

・「Fleeting Beauty of Devil's Flower」

Noire fights hard in order to help Claire who is being captured and continued to be raped by Forneus. However, she suffers great defeats and her anal is used as compensation thoroughly each time. In the end, she is able to meet with Claire, but what awaits her is a harsh reality.

・「A Certain Executive's Boredom」

Shax, an executive Gatea, came to visits Forneus in the human world, but he can't find Forneus when he arrived. When Shax learns that Forneus is actually fighting Sacred Claire and Sacred Noir, he decides to attack the girls to lure Forneus out. So, Claire and Noire are violated as a signal for Forneus to present himself. Too bad for the girls, Forneus is still nowhere to be found. Even worse, Shax is now starting to enjoy bullying the girls and is starting to forget his goal!?


・「Farewell, Single-minded Lizardman」

After Tina successfully succeeded the throne, Setsu went back to her normal peaceful days. One day, while spending her everyday with both relief and loneliness, someone ring the bell to Setsu's house. When she opens the door, the one who stands there is Andrus who has crossed swords with her many time. However, he doesn't appear to have any bad intention at all, what is going on!?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=902815]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
本粉丝碟包含以下剧本：

・“隐形袭击者”
某天，学校里的男孩们举止异常，对女学生实施性侵。显然受到邪恶影响的男孩们甚至开始攻击无法变身的蒂娜和赛茨！事情发展到这个地步，弗涅乌斯会怎么办！？

・“牛头人的新娘”
神圣克莱尔战败并被俘。她作为囚犯、每天被魔兽牛头人侵犯的生活开始了。拉吉尔冷冷地俯视着克莱尔屈辱而不堪的模样。不断怀孕、生产、被挤奶的神圣克莱尔，命运将会如何！？

・“从今天起，我就是主人公！奢华生活的梦想与野心”
基金会干部后藤是权力与欲望的化身。他趁弗涅乌斯不在，成功在蒂娜和赛茨身上施加服从印记。借助印记的力量，他夺走两人的自由。失去自由后，女孩们在家里、学校，甚至变身后都遭到侵犯。后藤甚至盯上了发现蒂娜和赛茨异常的女孩。对女孩们来说不幸的是，他的性欲没有极限。

・“恶魔之花的短暂美丽”
诺瓦努力救出被弗涅乌斯俘虏、持续遭到强奸的克莱尔。然而，她一次又一次惨败，每次都被彻底用肛门作为补偿。最终，她成功见到克莱尔，但等待她的是残酷现实。

・“某位干部的无聊”
盖特亚干部沙克斯来到人间界拜访弗涅乌斯，却找不到他。当得知弗涅乌斯正在与神圣克莱尔和神圣诺瓦战斗后，沙克斯决定攻击女孩，以引出弗涅乌斯。于是，克莱尔和诺瓦遭到侵犯，作为让弗涅乌斯现身的信号。可惜对女孩们来说，弗涅乌斯仍不见踪影。更糟糕的是，沙克斯开始享受欺凌女孩，逐渐忘记了自己的目标！？

・“再见，专情蜥蜴人”
蒂娜成功继承王位后，赛茨回到了平静的日常。某天，她在安心与孤独中度过日子时，有人按响了家门铃。她开门后，发现站在门外的是曾多次与她交锋的安德鲁斯。然而，他似乎没有恶意，这是怎么回事！？
